title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: installPackage refuses a manifest the install declaration refuses (type, scope, unknown keys)
body:
Fixes #24086

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changed

`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.installPackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) parsed only `manifest.id`, so an in-process caller stored manifests that `POST /api/v1/packages` answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` for. cloud's AI authoring (`ensureNamedBasePackage`, `ensureAppPackage`) stored `type: 'application'` / `scope: 'environment'` this way.

- **The primitive judges the whole manifest with the door's declaration.** After the id leg and the `version: '0.1.0'` default, and before the namespace default and any write, the manifest is parsed through `PackageInstallManifestSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/api`). That is the declaration the door parses, `ManifestSchema` with `scope` narrowed to `project`. It is not `ManifestSchema`, which still admits `cloud` / `system` (the `domain:spec` seat's note 6231970586). Nothing in this file decides which values are allowed: no enum check, and no copy of the door's rule.
- **The refusal** throws `{ statusCode: 400 }`, the same spelling as the id leg. An HTTP boundary (`resolveThrownHttpError`) answers it `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. The message is `Invalid package manifest — manifest.KEYPATH: ISSUE_MESSAGE; …` (ISSUE_MESSAGE is the declaration's own wording), so a platform scope carries `packageInstallScopeRefusal`'s sentence verbatim. The door's `installBodyRefusal` is module-private in `@objectstack/runtime`, which depends on this package, so it cannot be reused here. This file surfaces the zod path and message instead.
- **The parse is a gate, not a normaliser,** as at the door. The parse's defaults (`scope`, `defaultDatasource`) are not copied onto the stored manifest.
- **Stored rows keep hydrating (the card's second bullet).** The read-back path is `PackageServicePlugin.start` in `@objectstack/service-package`, which hydrates `sys_packages` into the registry. It never judged `type` / `scope`. That tolerance is now stated in a comment at the seam and pinned on the real stack. It applies to the read only, and a new write of the same manifest is refused.

### File surface

All edits stay inside the claim's surface: `protocol.ts`'s `installPackage` region, the hydration read-back (`packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts`, comment only), pins, and the changeset. The pin sweep also touched fixtures outside `metadata-protocol` that feed this rule (listed below). No source edit was made in `packages/spec` or `packages/runtime`.

## Pins (the flipped answer is load-bearing)

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.install-manifest-declaration.test.ts` (new). Each refused manifest is checked for `resolveThrownHttpError(err)` = `{ status: 400, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' }`, for the key path it names, and for neither writer having run. The refused manifests are `type: 'application'`, `scope: 'environment'`, `scope: 'cloud'`, `scope: 'system'`, a missing `type`, and an unknown key (`pages`). The `cloud` case also asserts the declaration's sentence is surfaced verbatim. The id leg still answers first with `manifestIdRefusal`. Lit controls: a versionless `{ id, name, type }` installs with `0.1.0` and a derived namespace, and the stored manifest gets no parse defaults.
- `packages/services/service-package/src/install-primitive-declaration.test.ts` (new) runs on the real stack: `ObjectKernel`, `ObjectQLPlugin`, `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3, `PackageServicePlugin` and the real protocol. `application`, `environment` and `cloud` are each refused with 400 / `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and afterwards `registry.getPackage` is undefined and the `sys_packages` row is `null`. The versionless control survives a restart. The H3 pin publishes a `type: 'application', scope: 'environment'` row through the service's own `publish`, the write the primitive used to make. After a restart that row is hydrated as stored (`source: 'authored'`, values intact, no error line), and a fresh install of the same manifest is refused.
- **Flipped pin:** `hydration-convert-forward.test.ts` › "the install primitive is authoring-side and stays strict". The assembled HotCRM body (with `pages`) used to reach the registry, which refused it `422 MisplacedDefaultPageError`. The install declaration's strict close now refuses it first, so the pin asserts `400` / `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `pages`, and still that nothing is written. Its docblock was updated to match.

### Fixture triage (each fixture got its declaration added, not the rule relaxed)

The rule's consumer radius covers every caller of `protocol.installPackage` and every `duplicatePackage` source.
- 7 `metadata-protocol` test files installed `{ id, name }` or `{ id, version }` with no `type`. Each now writes `type: 'app'`, plus `name` where it was absent. The declaration requires both, and the door has always refused a manifest without them.
- 8 `objectql` protocol test files used `type: 'application'`, the off-spec value this card is about, as did `protocol.flow-canonicalizer.test.ts` and the `app.iojn` duplicate source in `protocol-package-lifecycle.test.ts`. Each was respelled `type: 'app'`. The `scope: 'environment'` kept on that duplicate source is stripped by `duplicatePackage` itself.
- Not touched, because they never reach the primitive: `runtime/src/app-plugin.disabled-seed.test.ts` (code boot), and `service-package` `hydration.test.ts` / `mysql2-tuple.test.ts` (stored rows and the service's own write).

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (defaults versus the parse): holds, with one refinement.** `PackageInstallManifestSchema` requires `id`, `name`, `type` and `version`, and `namespace` is optional. Placing the parse after the version default keeps the #2532 versionless install working. `type` has no default anywhere: the declaration requires it and the door refuses its absence. So a manifest without `type` is refused (settled by the four axes, see `open_questions` in the report). The in-repo callers that reach the primitive outside the door are `duplicatePackage` (it copies the source's `type`) and the unmanaged install's base (it copies `type` as an identity key). The door parses the same declaration first.
- **H2 (every caller is an authoring install): holds.** The in-repo callers of `protocol.installPackage` are the runtime door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`), `duplicatePackage` (it deletes `scope`), and `importUnmanagedPackage` (its `scope` key is a `base` disposition, not copied). None installs a platform scope. Platform packages reach the registry through `ObjectQL.registerApp`, which does not go through this primitive.
- **H3 (hydration path): holds.** `PackageServicePlugin.start` → `registry.installPackage(convertForward(rec.manifest), 'authored')` judges only the protocol handshake and the registry's own rules. The tolerance is stated there and pinned.
- **H4 (import edge): holds.** `PackageInstallManifestSchema` comes from `@objectstack/spec/api`, which `protocol.ts` already imports. `check-undeclared-dep-imports` exit 0.
- **H5 (envelope): holds.** The door answers `deps.error(msg, 400)` → `VALIDATION_ERROR` (`standardErrorCodeForHttpStatus(400)`). The primitive throws `statusCode: 400`, which `resolveThrownHttpError` resolves to the same `{ 400, VALIDATION_ERROR }` (pinned).

## Serial constraint with the producer

From triage 6228198471, verbatim: "**⛔ Serial with the producer.** The producer half is objectstack-ai/cloud#2948 (open, `pm:blocked`, assigned). The cloud pin that carries this refusal must also carry cloud#2948's change; otherwise cloud's AI authoring is refused on the first new base." objectstack-ai/cloud#2948 remains open as the producer half; this PR leaves it untouched.

The producer half's change is objectstack-ai/cloud#2978, the cloud PR for objectstack-ai/cloud#2948 (named by the `repo:cloud` seat 2 note 6236742886 on #24086). The cloud pin that carries this refusal must carry that merge. (Seat edit: the dev's addendum 6237799160 asked for this line, because the dev writes the body only once.)

## Verification

All readings are on head `e9ac2429aa` (`origin/main` `7d6ec91d2f` merged in, clean, with no overlap with the touched packages), in a cold cloud container. Builds and tests ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- **Build.** `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/metadata-protocol...' build`, `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-package...' build`, and a rebuild of `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` after the merge: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Tests on the final head:**
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 244 files passed, 3 skipped; 20638 tests passed, 19 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/service-package`: 9 files / 124 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/objectql` `src/protocol-*`: 54 files / 715 tests passed.
- **Before the fixture triage:** `metadata-protocol` had 34 failures across 7 files. Every one was a fixture manifest without a declared `type` (47 `manifest.type` issues, 4 `manifest.name`). That is the consumer radius the triage covered.
- **Typecheck:** `metadata-protocol`, `service-package` and `objectql` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`, debt held) all pass. The first `service-package` run failed with `TS2307 @objectstack/objectql` because `objectql` had no `dist` in this cold container. The pre-existing `hydration-convert-forward.test.ts` failed the same way. It was green after building the closure.
- **Ablation (one time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run against `src`).** Both suites resolve `metadata-protocol` from source: `./protocol.js`, and `service-package`'s vitest alias. The mutation changed `if (!declaredManifest.success) {` to `if (false && ...)`. Anchor 1 to 0, blob `115a51f6` to `0f44c5c3`.
  - `protocol.install-manifest-declaration.test.ts`: 7 failed, 3 passed. The 6 refusals and the surfaced-sentence pin went red. The id-order pin and both lit controls stayed green.
  - `service-package` (`install-primitive-declaration` and `hydration-convert-forward`): 5 failed, 5 passed. The real stack registered and stored the off-spec manifests, which reproduces the defect. The hydration half of the H3 pin stayed green and only its fresh-write assertion went red, as designed.
  - Restored: blob equals HEAD (`115a51f6`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Changeset gates:**
  - `pnpm check:adr-0087-registration`: exit 0. It reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0, "This diff introduces no `major` bump".
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) printed 69 commands on `e9ac2429aa`. All 69 ran with exit codes captured before any pipe, and all 69 exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 69 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- **Earlier pass on the pre-merge head (58 commands).** It caught a real red, `check:test-source-alias`: the new `service-package` pins imported `@objectstack/spec/api` without an alias. I fixed it with one anchored alias in `packages/services/service-package/vitest.config.ts`, as the gate prescribes. Two gates refused on the shallow clone (`check-engine-split-ratio --days 90`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`) and passed after `git fetch --unshallow`.

## Acceptance notes

- `duplicatePackage` is a re-entry path for stored manifests. Duplicating a pre-change stored base or app (`type: 'application'`, `scope: 'environment'`, an `icon`) is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `manifest.type` and `icon`. The refusal is reported to the caller, and nothing is written to the registry or to `sys_packages`; this is pinned in `packages/services/service-package/src/install-primitive-declaration.test.ts` at head `a263c0885f`. The stored rows themselves keep hydrating. Repairing them belongs with the producer change or a migration, as recorded in the report's `open_questions`. (Seat edit, from the dev's addendum 6237799160.)
